arxiv-2502-18678.description: Abstract . This work is inspired by recent experimental observations in ultracold atomic Bose-Fermi mixtures [DeSalvo et al., Nature 568 (2019)]. uslaw-usc-t35-s172.title: 35 U.S.C. § 172 — Right of priority
uslaw-usc-t35-s172.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t35-s172.description: United States Code, Title 35 (Patents); Part II (Patentability Of Inventions And Grant Of Patents); Chapter 16 (Designs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The right of priority provided for by subsections (a) through (d) of section 119 shall be six months in the case of designs. The right of priority provided for by section 119(e) shall not apply to designs.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2006c.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2006c — Supervised credit
uslaw-usc-t7-s2006c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2006c.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 50 (Agricultural Credit); Subchapter IV (Administrative Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall provide adequate training to employees of the Farmers Home Administration on credit analysis and financial and farm management to— (1) better acquaint the employees with what constitutes adequate financial data on which to base a direct or guaranteed loan approval.
